title: Oppositions and Rectification
short: Contested proceedings before the Registrar and the High Courts: opposing conflicting marks and removing registrations that should not exist.
intro: Opposition is the most cost-effective enforcement tool a brand owner has. A conflicting mark stopped at the Journal stage never becomes a registration that has to be litigated. We watch for conflicting applications, advise on whether to oppose, and run the proceeding from the notice of opposition through evidence and hearing.

We also act for applicants defending oppositions, and we bring and defend rectification and cancellation petitions against registrations that were wrongly granted, have fallen into non-use or are being used to block a legitimate business.
services: Watch notices and advice on whether a published mark warrants opposition
Evidence under Rules 45, 46 and 47: affidavits, exhibits and evidence in reply
Written submissions and appearance at opposition hearings
Rectification and cancellation petitions under Sections 47 and 57, before the Registrar and the High Courts
Non-use cancellation actions and defence of registrations against non-use attacks
Settlement, coexistence and withdrawal arrangements that end a proceeding on sound terms
Appeals from opposition and rectification decisions

process.title: Assessment
process.text: A written view on prospects, cost and the commercial value of proceeding, before any filing.

process.title: Pleadings
process.text: Notices and counter-statements drafted to frame the issues that will decide the matter at hearing.

process.title: Evidence
process.text: Evidence assembled to the standard a hearing officer or judge will apply, filed within the strict timelines of the Rules.

process.title: Hearing and after
process.text: Oral argument on a written foundation, and advice on appeal or enforcement once the order issues.
